sentences.text: Bail Application No. 197 Of 2024

Karbhari Bapusaheb Fatak
 Versus
 The State of Maharashtra
 ...

Advocate for Applicant : Mr. Jadhav Satej S
App for Respondents: Mr. Satish A. Gaikwad
Advocate to assist the A.P.P. : Mr. Y. V. Kakde
 .....
 Coram : Sanjay A. Deshmukh, J.
Dated : 16th April, 2024.
Per Court :-
1.
Learned advocate for the applicant seeks leave to amend the application seeking temporary bail to the applicant so as to enable him to attend the marriage of his daughter Deepali.

2. Heard learned A.P.P. for the respondent and Mr. Kakde, learned advocate to assist the A.P.P.
3.

Learned advocate for the applicant is relying upon the marriage invitation card,
photographs of engagement ceremony of the applicant's daughter and her proposed husband, showing offering garlands to each other during the engagement ceremony.
These documents are taken on record and marked as "X-1" collectively for identification.

Considering the urgency in the matter that the marriage of the daughter of applicant is scheduled to be performed on 18.04.2024, the oral prayer of the applicant to amend the application for granting interim bail is allowed.
The applicant to carry out the amendment forthwith.

sentences.text: Heard learned advocate for the applicant.
He submits that the marriage of the applicant's daughter is scheduled to be performed on 18.4.2024.
He placed reliance on the marriage invitation card.

He submits that an affidavit of Jaydeep Vitthalrao Ghawte, the proposed son-in-law of the applicant, would be filed in support of the oral prayer that there is marriage of the daughter of the applicant viz. Deepali.

6. Considering the peculiar set of facts of the case and without entering into the merits of the matter,
temporary bail can be granted to the applicant so as to enable him to remain present for the marriage of his daughter Deepali.

7. In view of the above, subject to filing of an affidavit of Jaydeep Vitthalrao Ghawte, the proposed son-in-law of the applicant, to the effect that there is marriage of daughter of the applicant viz.
Deepali, the applicant in connection with crime No. 1155 of 2022 registered with Rahuri police station, District Ahmednagar for the offences punishable under Sections 409, 420, 465, 477-A r.w.
34 of I.P.C. and ba197.24 under Section 3 of M.P.I.D. Act, the applicant be released on temporary bail on furnishing personal bond of Rs.15,000/- with one surety of the like amount, for a period of four days i.e. from afternoon of 17.04.2024 till the evening of 20.04.2024.
Needless to state that the applicant shall surrender before the concerned jail authority, till the evening of 20.04.2024.
8. Stand over to 17.04.2024.

(SANJAY A. DESHMUKH, J.) rlj/
